proof.criterion: First item (spec v7): the image probe's attempt is bounded by max(slow_command_timeout_seconds, worker_boot_timeout_seconds + 60 s); `legion start --check-config` prints the derived bound after its OK line only when it exceeds slow_command_timeout_seconds; nothing is refused; tmux prints no such line.
proof.surface: The branch's `legion start --check-config` on /tmp/cc/run.yaml, a copy of deploy/kubernetes/daemon/legion.yaml.example with every file it names present (three token files, two generated PEMs, a kubeconfig naming context legion-daemon) and LEGION_POSTGRES_DSN set; each case appends the keys to a copy.
proof.command: LEGION_POSTGRES_DSN=postgres://legion@localhost:5432/legion /tmp/legion start --check-config --config case.yaml for: the example as is; worker_boot_timeout_seconds 600; 600 + slow_command_timeout_seconds 700; 240; 241; 300; 600 + 659; 600 + 660; and a tmux copy (runtime block and advertise_host removed) with 600
proof.observed: Every case `Config OK: project=WIDGETS`, exit 0, nothing on stderr. Defaults: no probe line. 600: `image probe: each attempt waits 660s: worker_boot_timeout_seconds (600) + 60s is above slow_command_timeout_seconds (300)` between the OK line and the plugins line. 600/700: no line. 240 (bound 300 equals 300): no line. 241: `waits 301s: … (241) + 60s is above … (300)`. 300/300: `waits 360s`. 600/659: `waits 660s … (659)`. 600/660: no line. tmux with 600: no probe line, only the two configuration-sourced gaps. The budget reaching the probe (imageProbe for both the booting daemon and probe-boot) is pinned by TestProbeBudgetIsTheLargerOfTheTwoTimeoutsPlusAMargin; the stop firing under the 600-over-300 shape by TestProbeImagesCapacityStopNeedsTheBudgetToOutliveTheBootTimeout; both in CI's Tests run.
proof.negativeControl: The fork-point `legion start --check-config` on the 600 file: `Config OK` and the plugins line with no probe line (the relation was neither derived nor named before this change).

proof.criterion: Provenance: a deployment row carries `source: configuration | boot` on the wire (contract 25) and in the boot log, and `--check-config` prints exactly the open rows whose source is the configuration.
proof.surface: CI's Stage 1 live proof (scripts/e2e/stage1-skeleton.sh: a real daemon on a Postgres container serving GET /legion/v1/state, in the Tests workflow's test job) read from its log; and the branch's `legion start --check-config` on the kubernetes and tmux scratch files above.

proof.criterion: Spec item 5: the worker image's language servers install from a committed lockfile with scripts off, reproducibly, and the installed typescript-language-server resolves the TypeScript installed beside it.

proof.criterion: Spec item 6: the probe's log tail kept for a refusal has a byte cap, kept from the end so the OK line stays in reach.
proof.surface: In-package (unexported `lastBytes`, internal/runtime/sandbox): a throwaway test, deleted after the run, comparing it with a reference implementation (keep the last `keep` bytes, drop through the first newline, prefix …) over boundary streams and reader shapes; no probe pod can run from this pod, so the refusal quote itself is pinned by TestLastBytesKeepsTheEndOfTheTail and TestProbeImagePassesOnALongLogWithTheOKLineLast in CI.
proof.command: go test ./internal/runtime/sandbox/ -run TestThrowaway -count=1 -v (cases: empty; exactly keep; keep+1 with and without a newline; a cut landing on a line boundary; only newlines; no newline in the kept tail; 1000 lines forcing many compactions; keep 1; a single line over keep; 2000 random streams, each under plain, one-byte, half and data-err readers; a reader failing mid-stream)
proof.observed: Every case equal to the reference under every reader shape; the mid-stream error is returned wrapped (errors.Is). Behind `io.LimitReader(…, probeLogReadBytes)` as probeLog reads, a 100-line tail of 11 KiB lines (1.07 MiB) loses its OK line — the 1 MiB read bound the code documents (100 lines of up to 10 KiB), not a defect against the spec's cap.
proof.negativeControl:
The same reference comparison with the cut landing exactly on a line boundary (`aaa
bbb
ccc
`, keep 8): both drop the whole line `bbb` and answer `…ccc
` — the documented drop-through-the-first-newline, so one complete line can go with the partial one; the OK line, last, is never it.

The published image (sha-6b44560d05a1) was not run here (no Docker); its `legion probe-image` ran in the Worker Image run's publish gate, and the same binary's code paths were driven on this pod's tree.
